title: Brief agreement is not a new request
The user is confirming the framing
Agreement does not require a new explanation
A direct request for brevity should lead to a brief answer
A quoted tone phrase may be a reaction, not a rewrite request
A quoted command should not trigger execution guidance
A quoted title may simply be confirmation
A quoted evaluative phrase should not turn into a lecture
A quoted legal classification may signal disagreement
A quoted format label should not automatically produce the document
